findings.title: CDK custom-resource provider Lambda uses Docker/pip asset bundling; AC-1 cdk synth not guaranteed Docker-free
findings.problem: from_asset bundling runs in Docker at synth time when local bundling is unavailable. AC-1 (cdk synth succeeds) and AC-5 are deploy-free synth gates; if Docker is absent, synth fails. The design leaves the Docker-free route as a deferred implementation-time fallback rather than specifying it.
findings.fix: Pin a Docker-free synth path: either configure local ILocalBundling first (pip into output on host), or vendor a pre-populated no-bundling asset, or make the prebuilt LayerVersion the primary design. State explicitly that cdk synth runs without Docker.

findings.title: App lazy bootstrap_index() path under-specified; conflicts with notebook-must-run-first
findings.problem: The app's lazy bootstrap_index() has undefined trigger timing, concurrency (multiple Streamlit sessions racing CreateIndex), and empty-index semantics. It also conflicts with the §Ingest note that 'the notebook must run once before the app can query' — a lazily-created index has no catalog vectors, so every lookup returns not_found.
findings.fix: Pick one model. Recommended: drop the app lazy bootstrap; make the index a notebook-created prerequisite; on app start call GetIndex and raise a clear fatal ConfigError if NotFound. If kept, specify trigger point, ConflictException-as-success under concurrency, and resolve the empty-index conflict.

findings.title: expected_dimension: 1024 default plus embeddingDimension hint reintroduce the unverified 1024 value
findings.problem: The committed default expected_dimension: 1024 will make the bootstrap mismatch check hard-fail on first run if Nova 2's actual length differs; 1024 is sent as a request hint too. Not load-bearing for CreateIndex (AC-7 still met by measurement), but a footgun.
findings.fix: Default expected_dimension: null (accept and log the measured value on first bootstrap); send embeddingDimension only when non-null; keep the mismatch check for explicitly-pinned values.

findings.title: aspect_ratio [DOC] value in generate_image has no correctness gate
findings.problem: aspect_ratio is a [DOC] enum; a wrong value fails every live generate_image call and mocked tests cannot catch it. Unlike image_lookup there is no generate-side smoke check.
findings.fix: Either omit aspect_ratio (use service default) or add a first-integration smoke step for generate_image/inpaint/outpaint asserting a non-filtered images[0] returns, referenced from §Testability.

findings.title: IAM fan-out ARN set is a static config snapshot that can drift from the invoked profile ids
findings.problem: The fan-out region set is a committed static list; if a us. profile's fan-out changes, InvokeModel can AccessDenied in an ungranted region (the design's error-handling already anticipates this).
findings.fix: Note the list is a verified snapshot to re-check via GetInferenceProfile on profile-id change, and make the ARN-builder unit test assert a foundation-model ARN is emitted for every region in inference_profile_fanout_regions per us. id.

findings.title: get_weather docstring puts the semantic value in the Strands status slot
findings.problem: Prose shows {"status": "not_found", ...}, but the mandated envelope uses status in {success,error} with the semantic outcome under nested result. status="not_found" is an invalid ToolResult.status.
findings.fix: Make it status="success" with nested {"result":"not_found","description":"<default>","temperature_f":null}, consistent with the ok()/err() envelope used by the other tools.
